must_fix: tools/r6_batch.py:model_handoff, lines 60–61 and 92–97: Journal.consume durably records the receipt before a separate save clears current_model_event. Crash between those saves, then resume the registered decision through r6_finalize_job.finish_and_decide. The receipt fast path returns verified_decision without clearing the stale marker; decision recording also leaves it intact. Finalization can return a proposal while current_model_event still names the completed worker, permanently blocking subsequent submit/analysis with MODEL_HANDOFF_STILL_ACTIVE or NOT_IDLE. Reproduced by executing the unchanged function in memory with an in-memory journal and successful receipt-verifier stub: replay returned the decision, retained MODEL_REVIEW/current_model_event, and no_model_workers rejected it. Minimal remedy: atomically persist receipt consumption and matching active-marker clearance, plus idempotent recovery of existing split states after verifying terminal cleanup. Clear only this event's marker, preserve later phases and failure facts, and never redispatch. Add a crash-injection regression between consume and phase save; existing decision-artifact crash coverage does not exercise this gap.
